segments.an5.230:1.3: Kodhano, upanāhī, ghoraviso, dujjivho, mittadubbhī – ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā kaṇhasappe.
segments.an5.230:2.4: Tatridaṃ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa ghoravisatā – yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, mātugāmo tibbarāgo.
segments.an5.230:2.6: Tatridaṃ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa dujjivhatā – yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, mātugāmo pisuṇavāco.
segments.an5.230:2.8: Tatridaṃ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa mittadubbhitā – yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, mātugāmo aticārinī.
segments.an5.230:2.10: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā mātugāme”ti.
segments.an5.230:3.3: Dve ca kulūpakā bhogā, bhattaṃ sappāpare duveti.
